title: Jubilant Light British Suet Spotted Dick
description: A traditional British dessert with a light and grassy twist, featuring suet and sesame seed oil, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, suet, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and sesame seed oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the dried currants and lemon zest.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x5 inch loaf pan.
Bake for 45 minutes, then deglaze with an additional 1 tablespoon of sesame seed oil.
Continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the spotted dick is golden brown and firm to the touch.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
